name: Tutorial Tom
source:
The first person [url=/c143276]Flippy[/url] meets after waking up in the killing game, Tutorial Tom is a friendly and positive dog. As his name implies, Tom was responsible for guiding toons through the "toontorial" of Toontown. He functions as a sidekick for Flippy and is always supportive of him. 

[spoiler]Tom's biggest dream was to be a teacher but he was rejected from a teaching job by [url=/c143357]Professor Pete[/url]. Despite this, Tom forgives Pete and the two become close, with Pete harboring romantic feelings for Tom. It is unknown if Tom reciprocated his feelings. Tom is murdered by [url=/c143358]Lou[/url] and [url=/c143294]Moe[/url] in Chapter 2; his murder is unavoidable.[/spoiler]
